commands.notes: Lifecycle rule: with a content block the diagram is saved and closed when the block ends (FileInfo with -PassThru); a throwing block saves nothing and removes the partial file. Without a block (Live set) -Path is optional and the live VisioDocument is returned unsaved; Save-OfficeVisio -Path writes it. With a block (Content set) -Path is required. Refuses an existing file unless -Force. No -Theme: Visio has no theme support today (see open questions). No alias: the command opens a block rather than running inside one.

commands.name: Open-OfficeVisio
commands.synopsis: Opens an existing .vsdx diagram; with a content block it edits, saves and closes it.
commands.notes: Replaces Get-OfficeVisio. Inside the block the DSL targets the first page; VisioPage adds pages. ShouldProcess covers the save that a content block performs.

commands.name: Save-OfficeVisio
commands.synopsis: Saves a live diagram to its own path or to -Path.

commands.name: Close-OfficeVisio
commands.synopsis: Releases a live diagram without saving it.
commands.notes: Added so Visio has the same New/Open/Save/Close lifecycle as other authoring formats. VisioDocument is not IDisposable today; the command releases the document and disposes it once the C# lifecycle makes it disposable.
